name: Junyi Geng
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong physical robot-learning fit through aerial manipulation and perception/control integration. The group now demonstrates learned visuomotor execution outdoors, offering a concrete CS-facing direction beyond conventional flight mechanics.

physicalEvidence.summary: A September 24, 2026 own-group preprint executes a U-Net Diffusion Policy on a fully actuated hexarotor with a four-DoF arm, OAK-1W camera and onboard FAST-LIO2 localization. Eighty indoor UMI demonstrations train a policy tested on physical peg insertion indoors and outdoors; the outdoor evaluation has only three trials. The current ARI roster identifies all three student coauthors as members, establishing a direct host-group link. The separate AM-Bench collaboration also deploys a learned lemon-harvesting policy.

shortVisit.summary: The full current ARI Join Us page explicitly welcomes summer interns and visiting scholars, separately from its PhD/master’s degree recruitment. It directs interested researchers to a linked interest form and publishes professional contact details. Duration, overseas-master’s classification, funding and summer2027 capacity are not stated.

unknowns: The new outdoor result is a short workshop/preprint study with five indoor and three outdoor trials, using a 20 mm peg and 50 mm opening. It is preliminary feasibility evidence, not a broad reliability estimate or a generalist VLA deployment.

AM-Bench’s twelve-task VLA/IL comparison is predominantly simulation; its real learned experiment is the separately described Diffusion Policy lemon-harvesting pipeline. Do not imply all twelve tasks or all VLA baselines were deployed physically.
The March 2026 near-wall physics-infused learning paper and April 2025 Imperative MPC paper explicitly evaluate simulation. They support current methods fit but receive no physical-execution credit.

Existing Penn State review: an external master’s student with a bachelor’s appears compatible with AC01 academic minimum as an inference, subject to host/administrative and separate immigration approval. Personal/family funds are expressly permitted in scholar guidance; its current published minimum is $2,625/month, below estimated actual costs.
